text:
marie-finance: Heads up — vendor CareAid (vendor_id CA-998) submitted Invoice #INV-2024-278 dated 2024-10-20 charging 20% VAT to Redwood, Inc. They say they're a UK charity but attached VAT number looks odd. Can someone confirm whether we should pay VAT and reclaim, or ask for a corrected zero-rated invoice? Also not sure about W-8/W-9 status.
jess-product: Which entity was the PO under?
marie-finance: PO 4083 was created under Redwood Ltd (UK). Invoice addressed to Redwood, Inc (US). Quick invoice snippet:```Invoice: INV-2024-278
Vendor: CareAid Charity
VAT reg: 123456789
Deliverable: Consulting hours (Q3) 80h @ $150 = $12,000
VAT 20% = $2,400
Total = $14,400```
accounts-payable: Putting payment on hold until doc check :no_entry_sign: please flag in Coupa.
sam-ops: If PO is UK entity but invoice went to US entity we need reissue to Redwood Ltd — otherwise tax residency mismatch.
liam-legal: Agree. For UK-charity treatment we need either: charity registration number (Charity Commission) or a written statement showing they're not VAT-registered for these supplies. If they are VAT-registered they should not charge VAT to a UK business under reverse charge? Actually reverse charge usually applies to B2B services with VAT-registered customers. Need to confirm whether we (Redwood Ltd) provided VAT number on PO.
marie-finance: PO had Redwood Ltd VAT: GB987654321. The vendor still charged VAT.
liam-legal: Ok — ask them for one of: charity registration link (gov.uk), or a corrected invoice showing 0% VAT with note "charity relief" or reverse charge note depending on their accounting. In parallel we need vendor tax form: if vendor is UK entity -> W-8/W-9 not applicable, but for our US tax purposes we want a W-8BEN-E only if they're foreign to the US and claim treaty benefit. Otherwise we keep vendor classification on file.
tax-bot: Automated doc check: Vendor CA-998 — no W-8/W-9 on file. Please upload supplier tax form to the vendor portal: https://vendor.redwood.example/docs/upload
marie-finance: I'll email vendor and request: 1) charity registration number + gov.uk link, 2) corrected invoice addressed to Redwood Ltd (GB987654321) showing zero VAT or appropriate note, 3) confirmation of VAT registration status, and 4) supplier tax form if applicable.
jess-product: cc'ing product ops contact so they can confirm service location if vendor disputes. @sam-ops
sam-ops: Confirmed service delivered to UK team.
accounts-payable: Noted — marked INV-2024-278 as "Hold - tax docs pending" in AP system. Once we have corrected invoice + charity evidence we can process.
marie-finance: Draft email to vendor (posting here to confirm wording):
```Hi CareAid billing team,
Thanks for the invoice. The PO is under Redwood Ltd (VAT GB987654321). Please reissue invoice addressed to Redwood Ltd and either remove VAT (if charity relief applies) or include reverse charge wording if applicable. Also provide your Charity Commission registration number or a link to your registration, and upload any supplier tax forms to our vendor portal so we can clear the payment. Payment will remain on hold until documents are received.
Best,
Marie (Finance)```
liam-legal: Good. Add: "Please confirm your VAT registration status and provide the VAT accounting note used to justify charging VAT to a UK business."
marie-finance: Sent to vendor 2024-10-21 10:12 GMT.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2024-278 status changed to ON_HOLD by accounts-payable at 2024-10-21T10:15:00Z
marie-finance: Vendor replied: "We mistakenly billed the US entity, we will reissue to Redwood Ltd and confirm charity number." They attached Charity number: 1122334 (link: https://register-of-charities.example/1122334)
accounts-payable: Thanks — once reissue arrives with zero VAT we'll approve. Leaving on hold until then.
marie-finance: Follow-up — vendor asked if we need a W-8BEN-E. I confirmed: not necessary for UK entity, but please upload any tax form you normally provide for us to keep on file.
liam-legal: Closing note: keep copy of corrected invoice + charity evidence in vendor file for audit trail. If vendor continues to charge VAT incorrectly after reissue, escalate to Procurement for vendor education.
accounts-payable: Marking thread resolved once reissued invoice received.
marie-finance: Thanks everyone, will update when reissued invoice is in.
